title: Charge-to-mass ratio
description: Essential: Correctly states the charge-to-mass ratio as g/E from the equilibrium condition in the electric field.

title: Velocity magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states the velocity magnitude as LgB/(E sinθ) by combining Lorentz force and geometry.

title: Minimum magnetic field
description: Essential: Correctly states the minimum magnetic induction B' as B/sinθ from the tangency condition.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: Applies the equilibrium condition qE = mg to relate electric field and gravity.

title: Lorentz force application
description: Important: Uses qvB = mv²/r to relate magnetic force to centripetal acceleration.

title: Geometric relationship
description: Important: Correctly relates magnetic field width L to radius r and deflection angle θ via L = r sinθ.

title: Tangency condition
description: Important: Recognizes that preventing escape requires the trajectory to be tangent to the upper boundary (r' = L).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns sign to charge or direction to forces, violating the equilibrium condition.

title: Geometry misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Misinterprets the relationship between L, r, and θ (e.g., using cosθ instead of sinθ).
